doc: The one route manifest for Network capabilities (owner, 2026-10-20).
The Kernel is the entry point for every client, so this file, not a client
framework, names the executor that serves each capability on each platform:
core          installed DS Core with its Network addon, reached through the
host's generic Core door (`core.command`) or, until Core
carries the capability as a command, one named host door
network_unit  the governed Network WASM unit in the page;
refuse        a typed refusal, with its code and message.
build.rs compiles this file into constant tables, and each Kernel build
serves one platform, chosen by a cargo feature (platform-core, the native
default, platform-desktop or platform-web): a malformed manifest fails the
build and no host passes or chooses a platform at runtime.
`page_lanes` bounds how many jobs a page runs at once; absent, the page uses
